reviews.snippet:
Had a cut in my knee due to an accident, the doctor was more interested in billing than look at the condition. Right from the beginning I knew I was going to be ripped off my money, they asked me get admitted or else I would be treated next day evening, for just a simple stich which I later got it done by a nearby clinic. By the way they did charge me 900rs for 5 mins just for dressing my wound and doc consult.
Hospital needs to ease patient's stress,not send them to trauma.
